name: JobSubmit
description: Submit an allowlisted Agon workflow to the long-lived daemon and return immediately with its job id.

kind.description: Registered workflow kind, such as brainstorm, review, or forge.

payload.description: Structured workflow payload. The daemon rejects unknown fields and never accepts shell or argv.

name: JobList
description: List autonomous jobs retained by the Agon daemon.

name: JobEvents
description: Replay bounded ordered events for one autonomous job after a sequence cursor.

name: JobResult
description: Read the terminal result for one autonomous job without blocking.

name: JobCancel
description: Request idempotent cancellation of one autonomous job.
